items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: The transcript only identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer. There is no mention of any personal or professional relationship between Bobby Militello and Monk Rowe in the provided text.

ctx.x: Bobby was interviewed in Buffalo, New York on October 14, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Buffalo, New York filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Bobby Militello with me today. I’ve been looking forward to talking to you because you see the music business from at least two sides.
